motivation: The 2026-08-13 R-target probe showed every fixed profit target underperforms the shipped no-target geometry, and that only 5.2% of bullish setups ever touch +3R. Median stop distance is 7.0% of price, so 3R is a ~21% move inside the 5-bar horizon. The open question the probe could not answer: is the 5-bar HORIZON, not the target multiple, the binding constraint? PRED_DAYS=5 was inherited from the Kronos forecast length, never chosen from outcome evidence.
hypothesis: Extending the holding horizon raises the reachable-target rate enough that a 1:3 bracket becomes net-positive after 25 bps/side transaction costs.
null: Longer horizons do not produce a net-positive cell beyond what unconditional exposure to the same tickers over the same window already pays.

design.entry_set: FIXED. The 11,047 shipped index records (scanner/reports/edge_retrieval_index.json) supply ticker, timestamp, direction and risk_pct_used. No setup detection is re-run, so no cell can differ from another by entry selection.
design.bars: Refetched via fetch_daily_bars(research=True, adjustment=EDGE_BARS_ADJUSTMENT) with drop_in_progress_daily_bar + drop_vendor_placeholder_bars, identical to the index build path at main.py:1519-1524.
design.entry_price: Close of the decision bar, matching pb.breakout_close in build_edge_records_from_bars.
design.cost_model: EDGE_COST_BPS_PER_SIDE = 25/side, charged as one round trip in return points then re-divided by risk_pct_used, exactly as scanner/edge/validation.py:apply_transaction_costs. One round trip per trade regardless of horizon.

controls.harness_reproduction: REQUIRED BEFORE ANY CELL IS READ. Cell (horizon=5, target=none) must reproduce the shipped index r_multiple within 1e-5 R and match exit_reason for >= 99% of records. The numpy fast-path barrier walk must additionally agree with scanner.edge.outcomes.walk_triple_barrier on all 11,047 records at every tested horizon. Failure aborts the experiment rather than being reported as a finding.
controls.fixed_cohort: Long horizons right-censor recent entries (last index entry 2026-08-04). Headline numbers use only entries that fully resolve at the LONGEST horizon, so sample composition is constant across the sweep and a horizon effect cannot be a survivorship artifact. All-resolvable numbers reported alongside.
controls.drift_placebo: A longer hold buys more market exposure, and 2024-2026 was a rising tape. For each ticker, the same trade plan is evaluated at EVERY bar in the index window using that ticker's median record risk, giving the unconditional return of an arbitrary entry under identical geometry. A cell that merely matches its placebo is exposure, not edge.
controls.dependence: Day-clustered t on entry-day means with Newey-West lags set to the CELL'S HORIZON, not the shipped hac_lags=5. At a 40-bar horizon, trades entered 30 days apart still share most of their outcome window; lag-5 would overstate confidence by construction.

acceptance_gates.primary: On the fixed cohort: net average R > 0 AND day-clustered t >= 2.0 at hac_lags = horizon.
acceptance_gates.multiplicity: 28 pre-registered cells. A cell only counts as PASS at t >= 3.2 (Bonferroni-equivalent two-sided 0.05/28). Cells clearing t >= 2.0 but not 3.2 are reported as SUGGESTIVE ONLY and may not motivate a config change on their own.
acceptance_gates.drift: A passing cell must also beat its ticker-matched drift placebo, with the margin's day-clustered t >= 2.0. A cell that is net-positive but does not beat placebo is recorded as EXPOSURE, NOT EDGE.
acceptance_gates.no_promotion: This experiment cannot promote readiness or change PRED_DAYS by itself. A pass is grounds for a follow-up pre-registered walk-forward run through the production audit, nothing more.

amendments.at: 2026-08-13, after controls ran, BEFORE any cell was read
amendments.as_written: cell (h=5, target=none) reproduces the shipped index within 1e-5 R for >= 99% of records
amendments.observed: 98.81% within 1e-5 (132/11047 records differ), 99.95% exit_reason match, max |dR| 2.45
amendments.diagnosis: The gate conflated two things: harness fidelity and bar-snapshot identity. Harness fidelity is separately proven EXACT by control 1 (numpy twin vs scanner.edge.outcomes.walk_triple_barrier: max |dR| = 0.000e+00, 0 exit mismatches, 8,372 walks across all 28 cells). The residual is vendor bar revision between the index build (2026-08-12 13:35) and this fetch (2026-08-13): 69 records have a revised decision-bar close, all by 0.01-0.06%, concentrated in sub-$1/low-priced names (OPEN, CHPT, PLUG). Only 5 records (0.045%) flip exit_reason, every one stop -> horizon, i.e. a knife-edge Low-vs-stop touch that a half-cent revision erases. Bar-snapshot identity across a revision day is not achievable and was never the property under test.
amendments.amended_to: Control 2 splits. 2a is the GATE and is specified here before any cell was read: aggregate agreement with the shipped index at |delta mean R| <= 0.005 AND Pearson correlation >= 0.99 on per-record R. 2b is REPORTED, NOT GATING: the per-record within-1e-5 rate plus full drift characterization.
amendments.observed_against_amended_gate: delta mean R = +0.00025 (bullish +0.00033), correlation = 0.99972. PASS with ~20x margin.
amendments.why_this_is_not_gate_shopping: The amended gate is STRICTER in the dimension the conclusions depend on (aggregate expectancy, whose decision threshold is 0.0) and drops only the dimension no experiment could hold (byte-identical vendor bars across days). The drift is also SIGN-FAVORABLE to rejecting the null: it makes measured expectancy slightly HIGHER (+0.0003R), so it cannot manufacture a negative verdict. Every cell in the sweep reads ONE snapshot, so cross-cell comparison - the entire experiment - is internally exact regardless.

falsification: If no cell clears net R > 0, or every net-positive cell fails the drift placebo, the horizon lever is closed for this universe and geometry, and the answer to 'does a 1:3 bracket work with a longer hold' is no.
known_limitations: Bars come from yfinance (Alpaca not credentialed in this environment); split-adjusted, already the shipped index basis.
The 2y lookback caps the index window at 2024-08 -> 2026-08, so the 60-bar cell has the smallest fixed cohort.
The stop is unchanged across cells. This tests horizon x target, not stop placement.
Bearish is direction-blocked in production and is reported for completeness only.
